Listing #: FH1753222

Two Homes, One Incredible Cairnside Address

A truly unique opportunity in beautiful Cairnside: two completely separate three-bedroom homes on one erf, each enjoying breathtaking panoramic ocean views and an unmistakable treehouse-by-the-sea feel.

Offering exceptional value and incredible versatility, this standout property is ideal for dual-family living, rental income, Airbnb or B&B opportunities, or simply for buyers wanting the space and flexibility of two independent homes in one spectacular coastal setting.

Both homes are double-storey and thoughtfully laid out to make the most of the magnificent surroundings. Enter each home through the lower-level living areas and you are immediately greeted by sweeping views across Glencairn and the ocean beyond. The ground floors feature an open living area, kitchen and guest loo, while upstairs you'll find three bedrooms and a family bathroom, elevated to take full advantage of the outlook.

Constructed with timber framing and Nutec cladding, the homes have a charming coastal character that blends beautifully into the mountainside setting, creating the feeling of living amongst the trees while overlooking the sea.

Adding even more personality is the beautiful mosaic artwork found across the exterior and garage areas. These artistic details make this one of Cairnside's true character properties - distinctive, creative and unlike anything else in the neighbourhood.

A double garage provides secure parking, while a private garden offers a peaceful space to unwind, entertain or enjoy lazy afternoons surrounded by nature.

And then there is the location. Perfectly positioned in Cairnside to capture the light and sunshine, the property enjoys a clear outlook towards Glencairn Beach and is approximately a five-minute walk from both the beach and Harbour Bay Shopping Centre.

Two homes. Six bedrooms. Panoramic ocean views. One exceptional Cairnside property.

For buyers looking for outstanding value, flexibility and a coastal home with genuine character, this is an opportunity that deserves to be seen.
